headline: Tech correction and a hot jobs report have December Fed-hike odds near 75% going into Tuesday's October CPI.
rates: After October payrolls of +165K (vs ~65K expected), the 10-year rose to about 4.88% and the 2-year to about 4.53% on Nov 6.
fed: The Fed hiked in September and held in October; futures price roughly a 75% chance of another hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting, and I found no specific Fed speakers for this week.
oil: Brent is hovering near $100 (about $99.90 on Nov 6) after a roughly 9% drop earlier in the week, swinging on US-Iran talk progress against Hormuz tanker attacks.
geo: US-Iran talks mediated by Qatar are unresolved with Hormuz still effectively blocked, and the Nasdaq is down about 12% from its Oct 6 high on fears of a slower AI data-center buildout after the midterms.
